findings.message: Shieldbearer clearance for both classes requires in-engine verification: Hunter must double-jump from platform_mid_center (z=600) with sufficient vertical clearance over Shieldbearer at floor level (z=0); Titan must build charge-bash from room entry with ~400u unobstructed runway before reaching Shieldbearer at x=2000. Confirm with actual jump arc physics, enemy hitbox height, and bash impact validation.

Ledge Gunner sightline coverage to floor approach: Both Gunners (x=1800, z=600 and x=2800, z=900) must have verified downward LOS to z=0 floor level where Shieldbearer creates the chokepoint. Encounter design intent requires crossfire friction during approach for both classes; confirm platform geometry and camera frustums enable intended targeting coverage or rebalance archetype placement.
